quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor results briefing Q&A: Q1 2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 results briefing: the company said Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 16.98 hundred million, up 13.13% year on year, and net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1.88 hundred million, up 49.17%; chairman and CEO Cui Dong attributed the growth to downstream market expansion, forward capacity build-out and its own technology platforms. CFO Zhao Guohong said Q1 operating cash flow was RMB 579,936,770.98.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 16.98 hundred million (+13.13%); recurring net profit RMB 1.88 hundred million (+49.17%)

quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor results briefing Q&A: Q1 2026 (06-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Projects and margins (Q1 2026 results briefing): vice president and board secretary Zhou Yan said the IPO-funded three-dimensional multi-chip integration packaging project has total investment of RMB 84 hundred million and the ultra-high-density interconnect three-dimensional multi-chip integration packaging project RMB 30 hundred million, both advancing to plan. CFO Zhao Guohong said gross margin depends on product and customer mix and that depreciation from its advanced-packaging platform and capacity build-out is gradually showing; the company will raise utilization, optimise processes and strengthen cost control. Chairman Cui Dong said capacity is planned on a make-to-order basis from customers' forecasts and its own view of demand.
quarterly_data.figure: 3D multi-chip integration project RMB 84 hundred million; ultra-high-density interconnect project RMB 30 hundred million
